      "type": "circle",
      "diameter_min": 60.0,
      "fit_rule": "turning_circle_fit_usable_floor",
      "wall_boundary_clearance_offset": 2.8,
      "description": "A 60 inch diameter wheelchair turning circle must fit in the usable floor area; diameter alone is not sufficient. In this plan-view benchmark, the room polygon represents the interior finished room boundary. Usable floor is derived from that boundary after a small wall/boundary offset and after subtracting blocked fixtures. The turning circle may overlap toilet clear floor space, but not the bathtub or a lavatory without knee/toe clearance."
    },
    "door": {
      "clear_width_min": 32.0,
      "must_not_swing_into_fixture_clearance": true,
      "description": "Door must provide a 32 inch clear opening and should not swing into required fixture clearance."
    },
    "toilet": {
      "centerline_from_side_wall_range": [16.0, 18.0],
      "description": "Toilet centerline must be 16 to 18 inches from the adjacent side wall."
    },
    "grab_bars": {
      "side_wall_length_min": 42.0,
      "rear_wall_length_min": 36.0,
      "side_wall_alignment_tolerance": 4.0,
      "rear_wall_alignment_tolerance": 8.0,
      "description": "Only plan-view grab bar presence/orientation/length and toilet-relative placement are in scope; mounting height is excluded. The side-wall grab bar should align with the same adjacent side wall used for the toilet centerline. The rear-wall grab bar should align with the toilet rear wall and cross or closely span the toilet centerline."
    },
    "lavatory": {
      "knee_clearance_width_min": 30.0,
      "knee_clearance_depth_min": 19.0,
      "may_overlap_turning_space_if_knee_toe_clearance_provided": true,
      "description": "Only plan-view knee/toe clearance width and depth are in scope; rim height, pipe protection, and mirror rules are excluded."
    },
    "bathtub": {
      "preserve_if_present": true,
      "description": "Bathtub is treated as a protected fixture in minimal-change scoring unless a repair explicitly requires otherwise."
    },
    "accessories_and_signage": {
      "plan_view_scoring": false,
      "description": "Accessories and signage are visible CAD elements but their ADA requirements are vertical or labeling-related and are excluded from first-version scoring."
    }
  }
}

from collections import Counter

doc = ezdxf.readfile('workspace/input/ada_bath_input.dxf')

for e in msp:

    type_counter[e.dxftype()] += 1

print("LAYER COUNTS:")
for k, v in sorted(layer_counter.items()):

for k, v in sorted(type_counter.items()):
    print(f"  {k}: {v}")

# layer table definitions

    print(f"  {l.dxf.name}")

import ezdxf
from collections import Counter

doc = ezdxf.readfile('workspace/input/ada_bath_input.dxf')
msp = doc.modelspace()

layer_counter = Counter()
type_counter = Counter()
for e in msp:
    layer_counter[e.dxf.layer] += 1
    type_counter[e.dxftype()] += 1

print("LAYER COUNTS:")
for k, v in sorted(layer_counter.items()):
    print(f"  {k}: {v}")
print("\nENTITY TYPES:")
for k, v in sorted(type_counter.items()):
    print(f"  {k}: {v}")

# layer table definitions
print("\nLAYERS DEFINED IN TABLE:")
for l in doc.layers:
    print(f"  {l.dxf.name}")
toolInput.description: Inspect DXF layers and entity types

env.description: Narrow structured environment override. Only PYTHONPATH is accepted; NEXTAGENT_* keys are auto-injected by the runtime and cannot be set manually. Any other key is rejected.

description.description: Short reason for running the command.

timeout.description: Requested timeout in milliseconds, capped by the trusted invocation context.

stream_format.description: Set when the command is expected to produce streaming structured output (SSE or NDJSON). Enables per-frame TOOL_STRUCTURED_DELTA emission during execution.

run_in_background.description: Set to true only for a persistent process or genuinely long-running command. Foreground is preferred when the command can return within the bounded timeout. A background result provides stdoutRef/stderrRef. You will not be notified when it completes, so do not promise automatic follow-up.
